# **ESM 232 Assignment 2**

# **Conceptual Model**

The conceptual model (embed as picture) shows how we applied the function to the test climate data (clim.txt).

![](images/Almond%20Yield%20Diagram.jpg)

# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

# Load data

```{r}
clim <- read.table(here("data", "clim.txt"), header = TRUE, sep = " ")
```

# Filter data

Filter the climate dataset to only include January (1) and February (2). These are the months used in the almond yield model.

```{r}
filtered_clim <- clim |>
  filter(month %in% c(1, 2)) |>
  select(-wy, -tmax_c)
```
